_comment: Career-stage labels for individual schemes. Wording approved on 4 November 2026. Each label restates the official rule; the site never decides eligibility. 'fit' is 'likely' (shown as 'Likely fits your career stage'), 'check' (shown as 'Check eligibility') or 'info' (a neutral note, no verdict). Patterns are matched against the topic identifier, ignoring case.
question: When did you defend your PhD?

options.label: I'm still working on my PhD

schemes.name: ERC Consolidator Grant 2027
schemes.rule: PhD defended more than 5 and up to 15 years before 1 January 2027.

2022-plus.text: For PhDs defended 2012–2021; check eligibility if you have had career breaks.

2012-2021.text: Your PhD falls in the 2012–2021 window.

schemes.name: MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships
schemes.rule: Doctorate held, and at most 8 years' full-time research experience since it, at the call deadline.

phd.text: You need the doctorate by the deadline.

2012-2021.text: The 8-year limit counts research experience, not calendar years.

before-2012.text: Only possible with time outside research.

schemes.name: MSCA Staff Exchanges
schemes.rule: Secondments are open to researchers at any career stage.

schemes.name: MSCA Doctoral Networks and COFUND
schemes.rule: Organisations apply; the funded doctoral or postdoctoral posts are advertised afterwards.
